title: chore(ci): measure whether a hand-hung label survives the labeler's synchronize run
body:
Fixes #9867

## What this is

A measurement-first card: objectui#9867 asks whether a label hung by hand on a pull request, and absent from `.github/labeler.yml`, survives the `synchronize` run of `Auto Label PRs` (`actions/labeler@v7` with `sync-labels: true`). This pull request is both the instrument and the carrier: the experiment runs on this PR and nowhere else, and the measured answer lands where the question is read, the header of `.github/workflows/labeler.yml`. `sync-labels` itself is not touched.

## Premise, re-verified on `origin/main` `961ceaa`

- `.github/workflows/labeler.yml`: `on: pull_request` with `types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]`, `uses: actions/labeler@v7`, `sync-labels: true`, and the header sentence "The action applies the whole set in ONE `setLabels` call" all present.
- `.github/labeler.yml`: declares no `pm:` label, no `needs:` label, no `needs-user-decision`, no `question`.

## The experiment (one real push decides it)

1. Commit `a024b78` (the changeset; empty frontmatter = no release) opens this PR. The labeler run on that head is awaited and the label set read back: **L0**.
2. A probe label is hung by hand with `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` (additive `POST .../issues/N/labels`): `question`. It exists in the repository, `.github/labeler.yml` does not mention it, and no gate or patrol reads it (grep of `.github`, `scripts` and `.claude` here and of `scripts/pm` in objectstack, with `skip-changeset` as the positive control). Read back: **L1**.
3. The second commit edits the header of `.github/workflows/labeler.yml`: a real `synchronize` push, not an empty commit. It touches `.github/workflows/**`, so the labeler's computed set changes (`configuration`, `ci/cd` join it) and the run has to call `setLabels`. That matters: a run whose computed set equals the existing one skips the call entirely and could not tell the two readings apart. Read back after the run: **L2**.
4. Probe in L2 means reading 2 (only labels the config manages are removed); probe absent means reading 1 (the whole set is replaced).
5. A last commit writes the measured answer into the header (the push that produces a reading cannot also carry it, nor its own sha), then the probe label is removed and read back absent.

⚠️ This body is written once, when the PR is opened, before any reading exists. The readings (L0, L1, L2, both head shas, both labeler run ids) are in the commit messages on this branch and in the `os-dev-report` comment on objectui#9867.

## Not measured

- **The race half**: a label hung between the labeler's read and its `setLabels` write. NOT MEASURED, reason: needs a timed concurrent write. Source reading only, not a measurement: upstream `src/labeler.ts` at the `v7` ref re-reads the PR's labels just before `setLabels` and keeps any label that appeared since its first read.
- Whether a label a seat REMOVES while a run is in flight is written back by that run. The same source reading suggests it would be (the write starts from the first snapshot). Not measured; recorded here, not filed.
- The sibling repository's labeler.

## Governed surface

`node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test .github/workflows/labeler.yml .changeset/9867-labeler-hand-hung-label-probe.md` printed `NOT GOVERNED — 2 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched.` The PR still stops at draft: it is a dispatched take (a `Claim:` is on the card), so ready and queue belong to the dispatching seat.

## Gates

Run after the final commit and cited with its sha in the `os-dev-report` comment on objectui#9867 (this body predates that commit).
